title: The local learner prediction runs without blocking the dispatcher's event loop
why: docs/evidence/step-9/s9-6s/result.json: spawnSync in callStudent blocked the dispatcher about 2.6 s per table.
runtime: none: no Docker, no provider or model call.
change: U/mapping-teacher.ts runStudent: node:child_process spawn; stdin JSON.stringify(inputs) then end; utf8 stdout.
U/mapping-teacher.ts callStudent is async and awaits runStudent; remainingStudent and proposeMapping await it.
Same command, args and env (PYTHONPATH services/geo, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE 1); same parsing and checks.
Not changed: the training spawnSync in U/chunk-mapping-learning.ts, the Python side, routing, teacher calls.

behaviour.case: no model path or no valid manifest version
exit 0, one valid line per column, same profileId and version
non-zero exit or killed by a signal
invalid JSON, schema failure, wrong count, profileId or version

behaviour.old: spawnSync timeout kills the child, STUDENT_UNAVAILABLE

behaviour.new: byte count kills the child, STUDENT_UNAVAILABLE; stderr only counted, never kept or logged

behaviour.old: blocked for the whole run (about 2.6 s, s9-6s)
behaviour.new: keeps turning; the call resolves when the child closes

tests: U/mapping-student.test.ts (new, 9): success with command, args, env and stdin; non-zero exit; invalid output;
wrong version; spawn error; stdout and stderr over 1 MiB (child killed); 30 s timeout with mocked timers
(not killed at 29999 ms, killed at 30000 ms); a 5 ms timer fires before a 50 ms fake learner resolves.
